record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. The popup is usually closed, so only an always-visible segment reaches the user then; the message and bell add the detail when a side pane is open.

## Counter-argument

Editing a user's status-right is intrusive, and the Claude Code status line segment already shows the same count.

payload.alternatives: only the message and bell while the dashboard runs; only the status-right segment; no alerts
payload.choice: A tmux status-right segment shows the needs-you count, and the running dashboard rings the bell with a tmux message when a new item appears

record.subject: needs-you-alerts
